_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Only 3% of 12h windows move the score ±2, so Denial holds in the coil; crowded longs and flat CVD are liquidation fuel for price, not a completed rung change.
next_move.brains_agree: partial — both read crowded leverage / seller control as bearish pressure; analyst alone supplies phase=Denial and tactical SHORT, narrative supplies no forward phase
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC stays inside $74,000-$79,000 next 12h, fear_greed 25-35, funding non-negative
next_move.invalidated_if: BTC reclaims and holds $78,500 (kills short) or loses $74,000 with funding negative and fear_greed under 20 (Panic rung)
